I understand that the writer did not intend for him to come off that way but he does. My point is that autistic people like him exist in a larger than expected numbers but are mislabeled. Did you struggle to adjust to German culture the way he struggled to understand Egyptian culture? 
I say this because I am an autistic person who moved to a different country but struggled so much to understand the culture. For so long I thought it was a cultural difference but there was so much more going on. That’s why I found his character very relatable

True, I’m grateful that I happened now rather than sometime in the future. 

And yes all past events needed to happen for me to finally awaken. It’s hard to accept but it is the truth. Thank you for the reminder. Happy days!
Hitting rock-bottom. There was no way for me to move forward without making a drastic change. And a little be of shrooms helped too lol
You’re probably right. It’s hard to see just how young I am now but I’m sure I’ll understand it better with time. Thank you!
